note: Descriptions below are the saved descriptions reported by a read-only audit on 2026-10-12. Retell UI types: Number, Selector (Enum), Yes/No (Boolean), Text.

fields.name: lead_score
fields.description: Calculate a lead score from 0 to 10. Add 2 points for a clear budget, 3 points for a 30-day or 1-3 month timeline, 3 points for pre-approved or cash buyer status, and 2 points for strong engagement when the caller asks follow-up questions. Subtract 2 points if the caller is just exploring. Keep the final score between 0 and 10 and return an integer only.

fields.name: appointment_intent
fields.description: Classify the caller's appointment intent as Strong, Moderate, Low, or None based on explicit statements and engagement during the call. Select exactly one choice from the allowed options.

fields.name: objection_raised
fields.description: Return true if the caller expresses an objection or concern about price, timing, a competitor, or commitment during the call. Otherwise return false. Base the result on the actual conversation; do not infer an objection that was not expressed.

fields.name: objection_type
fields.description: Classify the caller's objection as Price, Timing, Competitor, Commitment, or None. Select the primary objection explicitly expressed during the call. If objection_raised is false, select None. Use only the allowed choices.

fields.name: caller_sentiment
fields.description: Classify the caller's overall sentiment during the call as Positive, Neutral, or Negative. Base the classification on the caller's actual words and expressed attitude. Select exactly one allowed choice.

fields.name: required_fields_captured
fields.description: Return true only if all eight required fields were captured during the call: first name, last name, phone number, email, budget range, preferred location, property type, and timeline. Return false if any one of them is missing. Do not infer missing details.

fields.name: agent_asked_all_questions
fields.description: Return true only if the agent asked all five required questions during the call: budget, preferred location, property type, timeline, and financing. Judge whether each question was asked, not whether the caller answered it. Return false if any of the five was not asked.

fields.name: disqualification_applied
fields.description: Return true only if a disqualification condition was triggered (budget below the required threshold, the caller is already represented by another agent, or the caller is not a genuine buyer) and the agent properly ended intake. Otherwise return false.

fields.name: next_action
fields.description: Choose the next action based on qualification and call outcome. Select No Action Required if the caller was disqualified. Select Reassign to Senior Agent if the budget exceeds $800k or there is a complex competitor objection. Select Book Consultation if appointment intent is Strong or Moderate and all required fields were captured. Otherwise, select Send Follow-Up Email for Low intent or missing required fields. Use only the allowed choices.

fields.name: qa_flag
fields.description: Evaluate call quality. Pass if all required steps were followed. Needs Review if there is one minor issue. Fail if there are multiple issues or a critical failure, including required_fields_captured=false or agent_asked_all_questions=false. Select exactly one allowed choice.

fields.name: qa_flag_reason
fields.format_example: Agent did not ask about financing status.
fields.description: Explain the specific reason for the QA result. If qa_flag is Pass, return an empty string. If qa_flag is Needs Review or Fail, provide one specific sentence describing the issue. Do not invent issues that are not supported by the call.

fields.name: call_summary
fields.description: Summarize the call in exactly two sentences. Sentence 1: describe the caller's need, preferred location, budget, and timeline, using only information captured in the call. Sentence 2: describe the agent's closing action and the call outcome. Do not invent missing details; if information is missing, state that it was not provided.
